Name: (CR) Kisaa's Sleepy Glade Farm
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[center][size=3]In the deep woods to the west of Pelican Town, there lies a [b]sleepy little farm[/b] where the trees shelter you and the fireflies from the world beyond...[/size][/center]
[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Farm added through AdditionalFarms: [/b]Does NOT replace any Vanilla farms and is selectable from the farm type menu on starting a new save.
[*][b]Custom starter giftbox items: [/b]Lots of options. Choose before starting a new save.
[*][b]Custom fish/crab pot catch pool: [/b]Fish for Cindersap Forest fish in the rivers and ponds in this farm.
[*][b]Forest forage: [/b]Forage found in the Forest Farm spawn across this farm.
[*][b]Toggleable woods debris: [/b]The farm features the falling leaves effect in the Secret Woods, which you can toggle off if it's too overstimulating.
[*][b]Supports 3-person multiplayer![/b]
[/list]
[size=3]Want to adjust these features to your liking? You can do it all in the mod config! Install [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=3]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size][/url][size=3] for easier in-game customization.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Qfc2pd7/mod-contents.png[/img]

[b][size=3]Gameplay Elements[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]The grass in the farm is not diggable. [/b]The provided crop space can only fit a maximum of 2 Iridium Sprinklers, which is good for cozier, slow-paced gameplay or as a challenge map.
[*][b]Grass Starters can spread on grass terrain though! [/b]Don't worry about growing grass for animals.
[*][b]You can fish for Forest fish in all water bodies.[/b]
[/list]
[i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i]

[list]
[*][b]Starter Gift: [/b]Changes stuff you get from the starter gift box. [b][i]Configure before starting the save![/i][/b]
[*][b]Available options:[/b] Farmer (15x Parsnip Seeds), Florist (15x Tulip Seeds, 2x Bee Houses), Arborist (10x Tree Fertilizer, 2x Mushroom Log), Fisher (10x Bait, 10x Coal, 1x Fish Smoker).
[*][b]Woods Debris Effect: [/b]Toggles Secret Woods falling leaves effect. [b]Set to [i]false [/i]if you don't like this effect.[/b]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, etc.
[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with the following recolor mods: Vibrant Pastoral, Earthy, Starblue.

[u][b]Partially Incompatible[/b][/u] with [b]Grass Growth. [/b]MMAP added a new property that allows grass growth to be set as a tile property, which Grass Growth bypasses entirely. I use this MMAP property to allow grass starters to spread on grass tiles while keeping grass tiles undiggable. If you use GG, then this MMAP feature will not take effect.

[u][b]Not Compatible[/b][/u] with outdoor recolor mods aside from the ones mentioned above.

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties[/url]﻿ [b](MINIMUM v.1.11.0 REQUIRED)[/b].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]crystalinerose Tilesheets[/url]﻿ [b](MINIMUM v.1.3.1 REQUIRED).[/b]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Sleepy Glade Farm" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Have fun!
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Changes made to the [b]Woods Debris Effect [/b]setting mid-game will not take effect immediately. To correct this, [b]move to a different location before going back to the farm.[/b]
[*]Not yet properly tested on multiplayer.
[*][b]This mod is not made for mobile. Related inquiries will not be responded to and/or deleted.[/b]
[/list]
[size=3]Please [b]prioritize reporting any bugs here on Nexus[/b] by following the procedure outlined in the pinned post.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

Thank you to the patient folks in the modding channels for helping me during the creation of this mod!

A HUGE thank you to the amazing chu ([url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato]mushymato[/url]) for adding all the really cool MMAP stuff that makes the pretty visual effects for this map possible.
